context: User has a flat, lecture-y draft bit about respectability politics and wants it punched up to build and land rather than just argue a point.

checklist.name: identifies one contrastive claim
checklist.description: The revision is organized around a single identifiable 'there's a difference between X and Y' claim rather than a general opinion statement.

checklist.name: converts abstraction to concrete scenes
checklist.description: Abstract statements are replaced with, or paired with, concrete everyday scenes or images.

checklist.name: visible escalation
checklist.description: Examples are ordered or rewritten so later ones are more pointed or specific than earlier ones.

checklist.name: unhedged close
checklist.description: The revised bit ends on a tight quotable line with no softening qualifier attached afterward.

checklist.name: flexible use of optional techniques
checklist.description: Refrain, direct address, and imagined objector are treated as optional additions suited to the material, not forced in as a mandatory checklist.
